# Eman and Associates P.C.

> Boston-based business immigration law firm specializing in E-2 Treaty Investor Visas, led by attorney Emmanuel Okharedia. The firm handles the entire E-2 process under one roof: visa filing, U.S. entity formation, business structuring, and supporting transactions. Particular focus on Canadian investors (whose E-2 visa interviews are processed exclusively at the U.S. consulate in Toronto).

Key facts:
- Firm: Eman and Associates P.C. (EMAN & Associates)
- Practice area: E-2 Treaty Investor Visas and business immigration
- Location: 1 Washington St. #1362, Boston, MA 02108, USA
- Phone: +1-857-678-2406
- Email: e@emanlegal.com
- Book a free assessment: https://emanlegal.com/contact

## Articles

- [How Long Is the E-2 Visa Taking for Canadians Right Now (2026)?](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-canada-processing-time-2026): A current look at E-2 visa timing for Canadian applicants in 2026: consular wait times in Canada, what each phase takes, and how to plan around it.
- [Why E-2 Visa Applications Get Denied (And What to Do About It)](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-denial-reasons): The most common E-2 visa denial reasons, how to tell if a denial is correctable, and what your options are if your application is refused.
- [Can My Family Come With Me on an E-2 Visa?](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-family): Yes. Your spouse and unmarried children under 21 can accompany you on E-2 dependent status. Your spouse can also get work authorization. Here is how it works.
- [Can an E-2 Visa Lead to a Green Card?](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-green-card): The E-2 does not lead to a green card on its own. But there are real paths that E-2 holders use to get there. Here is an honest look at your options.
- [What to Expect at Your E-2 Visa Interview](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-interview): The consular interview is the final step before approval. Here is what officers ask, what to bring, and how to walk in prepared.
- [How Much Do You Need to Invest for an E-2 Visa?](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-investment-amount): The E-2 visa has no fixed minimum investment. Learn how the 'substantial' standard works, what real approved applications look like, and how to structure your investment.
- [How to Structure Your Investment for the E-2 Visa](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-investment-structure): The E-2 investment must be at risk and irrevocably committed. Here is what counts, what does not, and how to document it correctly.
- [Starting a New Business vs. Buying an Existing One for the E-2 Visa](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-new-business-vs-buying): Both paths can qualify for an E-2 visa, but they come with very different requirements and risk profiles. Here is how to think through the decision.
- [How Long Does the E-2 Visa Take? A Realistic Timeline](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-processing-timeline): The E-2 process typically takes 4 to 8 months from start to U.S. entry. Here is what happens at each phase and what drives the timeline.
- [Renewing Your E-2 Visa: What You Need to Know](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-renewal): The E-2 visa can be renewed indefinitely as long as the business still qualifies. Here is what the renewal process involves and what officers look for.
- [E-2 Visa Requirements: The Five Things You Need to Qualify](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-requirements): A detailed breakdown of every E-2 visa requirement. Learn what consular officers are actually looking for and how each element is evaluated.
- [Can You Use an Airbnb Business to Get an E-2 Visa?](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-short-term-rentals): Short-term rentals sit in a gray area for E-2 visa purposes. Here is what actually matters when USCIS and consular officers evaluate an STR-based application.
- [E-2 Visa Treaty Countries: The Complete List and What It Means for You](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-treaty-countries): Which countries have E-2 treaties with the United States? Learn which nationalities qualify, who is excluded, and what dual citizens should know.
- [E-2 Visa vs. EB-5 Visa: What's the Difference and Can You Transition?](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-vs-eb5): The E-2 gets you here. The EB-5 gets you a green card. Here is how the two programs compare and how entrepreneurs use the E-2 as a stepping stone to permanent residence.
- [E-2 Visa vs. L-1 Visa: Which One Is Right for Your Business?](https://emanlegal.com/blog/e2-visa-vs-l1): Both the E-2 and L-1 let you work in the U.S. through a business, but they serve very different situations. Here is how to tell which one fits yours.
- [What Businesses Qualify for an E-2 Visa?](https://emanlegal.com/blog/what-businesses-qualify-for-e2-visa): Not every business qualifies for an E-2 visa. Learn which industries and business types work, what makes a business 'non-marginal,' and which structures to avoid.
- [What Is the E-2 Visa? A Complete Guide](https://emanlegal.com/blog/what-is-e2-visa): A complete guide to the E-2 Treaty Investor Visa. Learn what it is, who qualifies, how it works, and what the process looks like from start to finish.
